description: JTBD agent skills for product discovery

plugins.name: jtbd-skills
plugins.description: Understand your customers deeply. Turn customer interviews or online feedback into an opportunity map of ranked jobs to be done, with the quotes behind each job and clearly labelled AI-estimated scores you can review and edit. Run /jtbd with your customer research files or start with a company’s website—for example: /jtbd https://www.airbnb.com/.
